verdict.rationale:
Better Auth documents both server-side (`auth.api`) and client-side (`authClient`) programmatic APIs, a CLI, and even an MCP plugin letting any app act as an OAuth server for MCP clients, plus its own hosted MCP server exposing docs/tools to AI clients (better-auth-docs-7,12,18,23,32,43; better-auth-probe-4,5,rt-1). This gives an AI-native user multiple documented, machine-consumable entry points to drive the product.
missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe-3 shows all candidate paths 404) and independent hands-on validation that an AI agent can fully drive auth flows via these APIs without manual glue code.
